r0.98-edge.label: r = 0.98 m, facing a sensor edge

calibration.barycentre_response: mean barycentre radius in 40 bins of r^2, made monotonic, inverted by interpolation
calibration.energy_constant: k = median(Q / E) over the calibration sample (k_mean = sum(Q) / sum(E) for comparison)
calibration.sample: 50000 events per configuration from the prior, seed 32
calibration.vertex_known_map: 80 bins of r^2 x 6 bins of the azimuth folded into [0, pi/M]

absorb.estimator_definition: k = median(Q/E); bias = median of E_hat/E - 1 per bin; resolution = half of the central 68 % interval per bin; the *_mean_* / *_std_* keys use k = sum(Q)/sum(E), mean and std
